name: flowlens
description: FlowLens workflow validation, analysis, and visualization workspace

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @flowlens/core build && pnpm --filter @flowlens/react build && pnpm --filter @flowlens/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @flowlens/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @flowlens/react typecheck && pnpm --filter @flowlens/web typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e
